verdict.rationale: Standing searches or alerts are a fair question for a research-notebook product, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows one-off source discovery ("discover new sources") and manual adding or sharing of content. Nothing documents recurring or standing searches, or alerts that surface new sources as they appear. A one-off discovery action is not a recurring schedule, and deferring AI generations is a different feature, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can set up standing searches or alerts that surface new relevant sources as they appear
